name: El Porvenir (Zacapa)
summary: A geologically distinct target from the rest of our portfolio — not an arc-volcanic system, but low-to-medium-enthalpy heat generated along the transcurrent Motagua Fault, the strike-slip boundary between the Maya and Chortí crustal blocks. A 2013 geological study across ~880 km² in El Progreso and Zacapa identified three zones of geothermal interest aligned with the fault and its hot-spring manifestations; early-stage, with recommended next steps including MT geophysics, hydrological balance studies and a preliminary conceptual model.
